notes.title: v1.0.1 patch
notes.content: Fixing the bug for cube manipulation using the keyboard when the cube is rotated.

notes.title: Dev Diary: Added 5x5x5 Cube and New Modes
notes.content:
Dev Diary: Added 5x5x5 Cube and New Modes

- Added 5x5x5 cube type.

- Introduced blindfolded mode where you play with the cube hidden.

- Added an option to limit the number of cube faces during play.

notes.title: Dev Diary: Added 2x2x2 / 4x4x4 Cube
notes.content:
Dev Diary:

- Added 2x2x2 and 4x4x4 cube types.

- Implemented cube rotation via right-click and zoom functionality via mouse wheel.

- Added cube scrambling functionality with a 9-digit seed.
